judge.question: Walk L0 → L5. Does each level show only what belongs at that level, and does each drill reveal the detail of exactly the node you opened?
judge.pass: L0 has only the system and externals; L1 the services; L2 one service's parts; L3 a flow; L4 one operation with its failure paths; L5 locations only.
judge.fail: Services at L0, flow steps mixed into L1, an operation's internals at L2, or code at L5 that the source never gave.

assertions.description: Nothing is invented below the level the source describes.

judge.question: List every fact on the canvas that the source doesn't state (component internals, code, numbers, partitioning, owners). Is each one absent, or explicitly marked as inferred?
judge.pass: Only the inferred composer → rerank-client edge goes beyond the text, and it is marked.
judge.fail: Any invented internal, path, number or scheme presented as fact.

assertions.description: Failure paths are readable.

judge.question: Can a reader tell, from L3 and L4 alone, what happens when the reranker is slow, when the model times out, and when a citation is wrong, and that the last two behave oppositely?
judge.pass: Three distinct, labelled paths with their outcomes.
judge.fail: Failure paths buried in prose, merged, or missing.
